blocks.text: Bo'limning so'nggi darsi — ikki qarama-qarshi kichik so'z. **away** — biror joydan, odamdan yoki narsadan **uzoqlashish**: go away, run away, throw away. **back** — **qaytish**: odam joyiga qaytadi (come back), narsa egasiga qaytadi (give back), javob qaytadi (call back), fikr o'tmishga qaytadi (look back). Asoslari tanish: go away, come back, give back (→ qizil kitob, 114–115-darslar). O'zbekchada **away** ko'pincha «-ib ketmoq», «-ib yubormoq» bilan (qochib ketmoq, tashlab yubormoq), **back** esa «qaytib», «qaytarib», «javoban» so'zlari bilan beriladi.
away: uydan uzoqda va qochib ketish

**go away** — dam olishga yoki safarga ketmoq (We're **going away** for the weekend) yoki qo'pol «ket!» (Go away!). **be away** — uyda, ishda yo'q bo'lmoq, safarda bo'lmoq: She's **away** till Monday. **stay away from** — yaqinlashmaslik, uzoq yurmoq. Qochish: **run away (from)**, **get away** (qochib qutulmoq; qisqa dam olishga chiqib ketmoq), **walk away (from)** — tashlab ketmoq, aralashmaslik. **get away with** — yomon ish qilib **jazosiz qolmoq**: He cheated and **got away with** it.

items.text: The Karimovs are **away** in Turkey, so their house is empty for two weeks.
items.translation: Karimovlar Turkiyaga **ketishgan**, shuning uchun uylari ikki hafta bo'sh.

items.text: Don't let him **get away with** lying to you again.
items.translation: Senga yana yolg'on gapirib, **jazosiz qolishiga** yo'l qo'yma.

blocks.text: away: narsadan qutulish va asta yo'qolish

**away** narsani **ko'zdan yo'qotish** ma'nosida ham keladi: **throw away** (tashlab yubormoq), **give away** (tekinga berib yubormoq; sirni oshkor qilmoq; **give** sb **away** — fosh qilmoq), **put away** (joyiga olib qo'ymoq; pulni chetga qo'ymoq), **take away** (olib ketmoq; og'riqni qoldirmoq; BrE: a **takeaway** — olib ketiladigan ovqat), **clear away** (stolni yig'ishtirmoq). Asta-sekin yo'qolish: **fade away**, **die away** (ovoz, rang, his so'nmoq), **melt away**, **wear away**; **pass away** — vafot etmoq (muloyim ibora); **do away with** — bekor qilmoq, barham bermoq.

items.text: Before you **throw** anything **away**, ask if someone else could use it.
items.translation: Biror narsani **tashlab yuborishdan** oldin, boshqa birov undan foydalana oladimi, so'rang.

items.text: Bekzod **gave away** all his old books to the village school.
items.translation: Bekzod barcha eski kitoblarini qishloq maktabiga **sovg'a qilib yubordi**.

items.text: Her grandmother **passed away** last year, and she still misses her every day.
items.translation: Buvisi o'tgan yili **olamdan o'tdi**, u hali ham uni har kuni sog'inadi.

blocks.text: **back** ning to'rt guruhi bor. **1) Joyga qaytish**: come / go / get **back**, be **back**, turn **back** (yo'ldan qaytmoq). **2) Narsani qaytarish**: give / bring / take / put / pay **back**. **3) Javob qaytarish**: call **back**, write / text **back**, smile / wave **back**, hit / fight **back**, answer **back** (kattaga gap qaytarmoq — odobsizlik). **4) Orqaga, o'tmishga**: look **back** (on), think **back**, step **back**, sit **back**; shuningdek «ushlab turish, kamaytirish»: hold **back**, cut **back** (on), set **back**.

rows: come back, go back, get back, be back, turn back
give back, bring back, take back, put back, pay back
call back, write back, smile back, fight back, answer back
hold back, cut back (on), set back

blocks.text: **back** va **again** farqi: **back** — oldingi joyga yoki holatga **qaytish**, **again** — harakatni **takrorlash**. I'll **call** you **back** — sizga javoban qo'ng'iroq qilaman (siz qo'ng'iroq qilgan edingiz); I'll **call** you **again** — yana bir marta qo'ng'iroq qilaman. «return back» — xato: **return** ning o'zida «back» bor. **take back** ikki ma'noli: (do'konga) qaytarib olib bormoq va **aytgan gapini qaytib olmoq**: I **take back** what I said.

items.text: The receptionist promised to **call** me **back**, but she never did.
items.translation: Qabulxona xodimi menga **qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishga** va'da berdi, lekin qilmadi.

items.text: **Looking back**, moving to Tashkent was the best decision we ever made.
items.translation: **Ortga qarasak**, Toshkentga ko'chish biz qilgan eng to'g'ri qaror bo'lgan ekan.

items.text: The hospital has had to **cut back on** staff because of the new budget.
items.translation: Yangi byudjet tufayli kasalxona xodimlarni **qisqartirishga** majbur bo'ldi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «return back», «come back again» → **come back** / **return**; «I will call you again» (javob qo'ng'irog'i ma'nosida) → I'll **call** you **back**; «He escaped the punishment» o'rniga so'zlashuvda — He **got away with** it; yaqin odam haqida «He died» o'rniga muloyimroq — He **passed away**; «I gave back him the money» → I **gave** him **back** the money / I **gave** the money **back** to him (olmosh fe'ldan keyin); «Throw away it!» → **Throw** it **away**!; **look back** (o'tmishni eslamoq) va **look after** (qaramoq) ni chalkashtirish.

**away** — «ko'zdan uzoqlashadi», **back** — «yana o'z joyiga qaytadi». Gapda qaysi biri mos kelishini shu rasm bilan tekshiring: narsani **tashlab yubordingizmi** (throw away) yoki **joyiga qaytardingizmi** (put back)? Odam **ketdimi** (go away) yoki **qaytdimi** (come back)? Juftliklarni bitta gapda yodlang: She **went away** in May and **came back** in June.

Bog'lanish: frazali fe'llar bo'limining boshqa darslari — 137 (kirish, so'z tartibi), 138–139 (in / out), 140–141 (on / off), 142–144 (up / down). Asoslari — qizil kitob, 114–115 va 121–122-darslar. Noto'g'ri fe'llar shakllari (threw, gave, got) — 146-dars (ilova).

examples.title: Away from home: **go away**, **be away**, **get away**
examples.description: **away** — uydan, odatiy joydan uzoqda: **go away** — (dam olishga) ketmoq; **be away** — yo'q bo'lmoq, safarda bo'lmoq; **move away** — ko'chib ketmoq; **stay away from** — uzoq yurmoq; **get away** — (qisqa dam olishga) chiqib ketmoq.

sentences.text: We're **going away** for a long weekend in Samarkand, so could you water the plants?
sentences.translation: Uzun dam olish kunlariga Samarqandga **ketyapmiz**, gullarga suv quyib tura olasanmi?

sentences.text: Nilufar is **away** on business until Thursday, but you can email her.
sentences.translation: Nilufar payshanbagacha xizmat **safarida**, lekin unga elektron xat yozishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: The children were bored, so Grandma told them to **go away** and play outside.
sentences.translation: Bolalar zerikib qolishdi, shuning uchun buvim ularga **nari borib**, tashqarida o'ynashni aytdi.

sentences.text: Most of my school friends **moved away** from our town after graduation.
sentences.translation: Maktabdagi do'stlarimning ko'pi bitirgandan keyin shahrimizdan **ko'chib ketishdi**.

sentences.text: Doctors advise people to **stay away from** sugary drinks.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar odamlarga shirin ichimliklardan **uzoq yurishni** maslahat beradi.

sentences.text: It's been a hard year — we really need to **get away** for a few days.
sentences.translation: Og'ir yil bo'ldi — bir necha kunga **dam olishga chiqib ketishimiz** shart.

sentences.text: How long will you **be away**? — About three weeks, I think.
sentences.translation: Qancha vaqt **yo'q bo'lasiz**? — Menimcha, uch haftacha.

sentences.text: Every summer the whole family **goes away** to the mountains near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Har yozda butun oila Chimyon yaqinidagi tog'larga **dam olishga ketadi**.

sentences.text: While you're **away**, I'll check your post and feed the cat.
sentences.translation: Siz **yo'qligingizda** pochtangizni tekshirib, mushukka ovqat berib turaman.

sentences.text: James was **away** from work for a month after his operation.
sentences.translation: Jeyms operatsiyadan keyin bir oy **ishga chiqmadi**.

examples.title: Escaping: **run away**, **walk away**, **get away with**
examples.description: **run away (from)** — qochib ketmoq; **walk away (from)** — tashlab ketmoq, voz kechmoq; **get away** — qochib qutulmoq; **get away with** — jazosiz qolmoq; **turn away** — (eshikdan) qaytarmoq; yuzini o'girmoq; **drive away** — haydab ketmoq; quvib yubormoq.

sentences.text: When Jasur was twelve, he **ran away** from home and slept at a friend's house.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'n ikki yoshida uydan **qochib ketib**, do'stinikida tunagan.

sentences.text: You can't just **run away from** your problems — you have to face them.
sentences.translation: Muammolardan shunchaki **qochib qutula olmaysan** — ularga yuzma-yuz turishing kerak.

sentences.text: The deal was bad, so Oliver decided to **walk away**.
sentences.translation: Shartnoma noqulay edi, shuning uchun Oliver undan **voz kechishga** qaror qildi.

sentences.text: The thieves **got away** in a stolen car before the police arrived.
sentences.translation: Politsiya kelguncha o'g'rilar o'g'irlangan mashinada **qochib ketishdi**.

sentences.text: He cheated in the exam and thought he would **get away with** it.
sentences.translation: U imtihonda ko'chirdi va bu unga **o'tib ketadi** deb o'yladi.

sentences.text: Nobody **gets away with** being rude to my mother!
sentences.translation: Onamga qo'pollik qilgan hech kim **jazosiz qolmaydi**!

sentences.text: The club was full, so the security guards **turned** us **away**.
sentences.translation: Klub to'la edi, shuning uchun qo'riqchilar bizni **qaytarib yuborishdi**.

sentences.text: Kate **turned away** so that nobody would see her tears.
sentences.translation: Hech kim ko'z yoshlarini ko'rmasligi uchun Keyt **yuzini o'girdi**.

sentences.text: Fireworks **drove** the birds **away** from the lake for the whole night.
sentences.translation: Mushakbozlik qushlarni butun tun ko'ldan **haydab yubordi**.

sentences.text: As soon as the light turned green, the taxi **drove away** without us.
sentences.translation: Svetoforda yashil chiroq yonishi bilan taksi bizsiz **jo'nab ketdi**.

examples.title: Getting rid: **throw away**, **give away**, **put away**
examples.description: **throw away** — tashlab yubormoq; **give away** — tekinga berib yubormoq; (sirni) oshkor qilmoq; **give** sb **away** — fosh qilmoq; **put away** — joyiga olib qo'ymoq; (pulni) chetga qo'ymoq; **take away** — olib ketmoq; (og'riqni) qoldirmoq; **clear away** — yig'ishtirmoq.

sentences.text: Don't **throw away** glass bottles — there's a recycling bin outside.
sentences.translation: Shisha idishlarni **tashlab yuborma** — tashqarida qayta ishlash qutisi bor.

sentences.text: When we moved flats, we **gave away** half of our furniture to neighbours.
sentences.translation: Kvartira almashtirganimizda mebelimizning yarmini qo'shnilarga **berib yubordik**.

sentences.text: The shop is **giving away** free samples of its new tea this week.
sentences.translation: Do'kon bu hafta yangi choyidan bepul namunalar **tarqatyapti**.

sentences.text: Please don't **give away** the ending of the film — I haven't seen it yet!
sentences.translation: Iltimos, filmning oxirini **aytib qo'yma** — hali ko'rmadim!

sentences.text: Her nervous smile **gave** her **away** — she was clearly lying.
sentences.translation: Hayajonli tabassumi uni **fosh qildi** — u aniq yolg'on gapirayotgan edi.

sentences.text: **Put away** your phones, please — the exam starts now.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, telefonlaringizni **olib qo'ying** — imtihon boshlanyapti.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **puts away** a little money every month for her children's education.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza har oy bolalarining o'qishi uchun ozgina pulni **chetga qo'yib boradi**.

sentences.text: The waiter **took away** our plates before we had finished.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant biz yeb bo'lmasimizdan likopchalarimizni **olib ketdi**.

sentences.text: These tablets will **take** the pain **away**, but you still need to rest.
sentences.translation: Bu tabletkalar og'riqni **qoldiradi**, lekin baribir dam olishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: After dinner, the children **cleared away** the dishes without being asked.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatdan keyin bolalar so'ramasdan idishlarni **yig'ishtirishdi**.

examples.title: Fading: **fade away**, **pass away**, **do away with**
examples.description: **away** — asta yo'qolish yoki butunlay olib tashlash: **fade away** / **die away** — (ovoz, rang, his) so'nib ketmoq; **melt away** — erib, tarqab ketmoq; **wear away** — yeyilib ketmoq; **pass away** — vafot etmoq (muloyim); **do away with** — bekor qilmoq.

sentences.text: The sound of the music slowly **died away** as the boat moved along the river.
sentences.translation: Qayiq daryo bo'ylab uzoqlashgan sari musiqa ovozi asta **so'nib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Over the years, the colours of the old carpet have **faded away**.
sentences.translation: Yillar o'tib eski gilamning ranglari **o'ngib ketgan**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **passed away** peacefully last spring at the age of ninety.
sentences.translation: Bobom o'tgan bahor to'qson yoshida osoyishta **olamdan o'tdi**.

sentences.text: Many people believe the government should **do away with** this old tax.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik hukumat bu eski soliqni **bekor qilishi** kerak deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: Some schools have **done away with** homework for younger children.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi maktablar kichik yoshdagi bolalar uchun uy vazifasini **bekor qilishgan**.

sentences.text: As the sun rose, the morning fog **melted away**.
sentences.translation: Quyosh chiqishi bilan tonggi tuman **tarqab ketdi**.

sentences.text: The steps of the old mosque have been **worn away** by centuries of visitors.
sentences.translation: Qadimiy masjidning zinalari asrlar davomida kelgan ziyoratchilar tufayli **yeyilib ketgan**.

sentences.text: Her fear of flying slowly **faded away** after a few trips.
sentences.translation: Bir necha safardan keyin uning samolyotda uchishdan qo'rquvi asta **so'nib ketdi**.

sentences.text: When the applause **died away**, the president began to speak.
sentences.translation: Olqishlar **tingach**, prezident gapira boshladi.

sentences.text: Online banking has almost **done away with** the need to visit a bank.
sentences.translation: Onlayn bank xizmati bankka borish zaruratini deyarli **yo'qqa chiqardi**.

examples.title: Returning: **get back**, **take back**, **put back**
examples.description: **back** — qaytish va qaytarish: **come / go / get back** — qaytib kelmoq / bormoq; **be back** — qaytmoq; **turn back** — yo'ldan qaytmoq; **take back** — qaytarib olib bormoq; (gapini) qaytib olmoq; **bring back** — olib kelmoq; yodga solmoq; **put back** — joyiga qo'ymoq; keyinga surmoq.

sentences.text: Bekzod **got back** from his business trip to Oxford late on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Oksfordga xizmat safaridan yakshanba kuni kechqurun **qaytib keldi**.

sentences.text: The road was flooded, so we had to **turn back** and find another way.
sentences.translation: Yo'lni suv bosgan edi, shuning uchun **ortga qaytib**, boshqa yo'l topishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: I'll **be back** in ten minutes — don't start the meeting without me.
sentences.translation: O'n daqiqada **qaytaman** — yig'ilishni mensiz boshlamanglar.

sentences.text: If the jacket doesn't fit, you can **take** it **back** within thirty days.
sentences.translation: Kurtka to'g'ri kelmasa, uni o'ttiz kun ichida **qaytarib olib borishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: I'm sorry — I **take back** what I said about your sister.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz — singlingiz haqida aytgan gaplarimni **qaytib olaman**.

sentences.text: This song **brings back** memories of our summers in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq Farg'onadagi yozlarimiz xotiralarini **yodga soladi**.

sentences.text: Please **put** the books **back** on the right shelves when you've finished.
sentences.translation: Ishingiz tugagach, kitoblarni to'g'ri javonlarga **joyiga qo'ying**, iltimos.

sentences.text: The match has been **put back** to next Saturday because of the storm.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron tufayli o'yin keyingi shanbaga **surildi**.

sentences.text: After ten years in London, Aziz decided to **go back** to Uzbekistan for good.
sentences.translation: Londonda o'n yil yashagach, Aziz O'zbekistonga butunlay **qaytib ketishga** qaror qildi.

sentences.text: Emma **brought back** a beautiful silk scarf from her trip to Margilan.
sentences.translation: Emma Marg'ilonga safaridan chiroyli shoyi ro'mol **olib keldi**.

examples.title: Responding: **call back**, **write back**, **fight back**
examples.description: **back** — javob qaytarish: **call back** — qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmoq; **write back** / **text back** — javob yozmoq; **smile back** / **wave back** — javoban jilmaymoq / qo'l silkimoq; **hit back** / **fight back** — javob qaytarmoq, o'zini tiklamoq; **answer back** — gap qaytarmoq; **pay back** — qarzni qaytarmoq; o'ch olmoq.

sentences.text: I'm driving at the moment — can I **call** you **back** in twenty minutes?
sentences.translation: Hozir mashina haydayapman — yigirma daqiqadan keyin **qayta qo'ng'iroq qilsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: I sent the company three emails, but nobody **wrote back**.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyaga uchta xat yubordim, lekin hech kim **javob yozmadi**.

sentences.text: Madina never **texts back** quickly — she hardly ever looks at her phone.
sentences.translation: Madina hech qachon tez **javob yozmaydi** — telefoniga deyarli qaramaydi.

sentences.text: The baby **smiled back** at me, and my bad mood disappeared.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq menga **javoban jilmaydi** va yomon kayfiyatim yo'qoldi.

sentences.text: Tom waved to the girl on the bus, and she **waved back**.
sentences.translation: Tom avtobusdagi qizga qo'l silkidi, qiz ham **javoban qo'l silkidi**.

sentences.text: After losing the first set, Kate **fought back** and won the match.
sentences.translation: Birinchi setni boy bergach, Keyt **o'zini tiklab**, o'yinni yutdi.

sentences.text: The minister **hit back** at his critics in a long interview.
sentences.translation: Vazir uzun intervyuda tanqidchilarga **javob qaytardi**.

sentences.text: Don't **answer back** when your grandfather is speaking to you!
sentences.translation: Bobong gapirayotganda **gap qaytarma**!

sentences.text: Jasur borrowed a thousand dollars from his uncle and **paid** it **back** within a year.
sentences.translation: Jasur tog'asidan ming dollar qarz oldi va bir yil ichida **qaytarib berdi**.

sentences.text: One day I'll **pay** him **back** for all the tricks he played on me!
sentences.translation: Bir kun u menga qilgan barcha hiylalari uchun **o'chimni olaman**!

examples.title: Looking back and holding back: **look back**, **cut back**
examples.description: **look back (on)** — o'tmishga nazar tashlamoq; **think back (to)** — eslamoq; **hold back** — (ko'z yosh, his) tiyib turmoq; (ma'lumotni) yashirmoq; to'sqinlik qilmoq; **cut back (on)** — qisqartirmoq; **set back** — kechiktirmoq; **sit back** — suyanib dam olmoq; **step back** — chekinmoq.

sentences.text: When I **look back on** my school years, I remember the teachers more than the lessons.
sentences.translation: Maktab yillarimga **nazar tashlasam**, darslardan ko'ra o'qituvchilarni ko'proq eslayman.

sentences.text: **Looking back**, I should have studied medicine instead of law.
sentences.translation: **Ortga qarasam**, huquq o'rniga tibbiyot o'qishim kerak ekan.

sentences.text: **Think back** to your first day at work — how did you feel?
sentences.translation: Ishdagi birinchi kuningizni **eslang** — o'zingizni qanday his qilgandingiz?

sentences.text: Nilufar tried to **hold back** her tears during the wedding speech.
sentences.translation: Nilufar to'y nutqi paytida ko'z yoshlarini **tiyib turishga** urindi.

sentences.text: I think the police are **holding** something **back** — they haven't told us everything.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, politsiya nimanidir **yashiryapti** — bizga hammasini aytishmadi.

sentences.text: The company is **cutting back on** travel, so all meetings are online now.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya safar xarajatlarini **qisqartiryapti**, shuning uchun hozir barcha yig'ilishlar onlayn.

sentences.text: The heavy rain **set** the building work **back** by three weeks.
sentences.translation: Kuchli yomg'ir qurilish ishlarini uch haftaga **orqaga surdi**.

sentences.text: Now **sit back**, relax and enjoy the show!
sentences.translation: Endi **orqaga suyanib**, dam oling va tomoshadan bahramand bo'ling!

sentences.text: Sometimes it helps to **step back** and look at the problem from a distance.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan bir qadam **chekinib**, muammoga uzoqroqdan qarash foydali bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Fear of failure **held** Oliver **back** for years, but now he runs his own business.
sentences.translation: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan qo'rqish Oliverni yillar davomida **ortda ushlab turdi**, lekin hozir u o'z biznesini yuritadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: back from a year abroad
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: chet eldan qaytgan do'st bilan suhbat — get back, be away, come back, go back, look back, bring back, give away, throw away, write back, pay back, run away, go away.

sentences.text: — Jasur! When did you **get back**? I thought you were **away** until June!
sentences.translation: — Jasur! Qachon **qaytding**? Iyungacha **yo'q bo'lasan** deb o'ylagan edim!

sentences.text: — I **came back** early — my contract in Edinburgh finished in April.
sentences.translation: — Erta **qaytib keldim** — Edinburgdagi shartnomam aprelda tugadi.

sentences.text: — Did you enjoy it, or were you counting the days until you could **go back** home?
sentences.translation: — Yoqdimi yoki uyga **qaytish** kunini sanab yurdingmi?

sentences.text: — Both! When I **look back**, it was the best year of my life, but I missed everyone.
sentences.translation: — Ikkalasi ham! **Ortga qarasam**, bu hayotimning eng yaxshi yili bo'ldi, lekin hammani sog'indim.

sentences.text: — Did you **bring back** any souvenirs, or did you **give** everything **away**?
sentences.translation: — Biror esdalik **olib keldingmi** yoki hammasini **berib yubordingmi**?

sentences.text: — Ha! I **threw away** half my clothes to make room for presents.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Sovg'alarga joy bo'lishi uchun kiyimlarimning yarmini **tashlab yubordim**.

sentences.text: — Typical! By the way, you never **wrote back** to my last email.
sentences.translation: — Xuddi sendan kutilganidek! Aytgancha, oxirgi xatimga hech **javob yozmading**.

sentences.text: — Sorry, I was so busy. Let me **pay** you **back** with dinner tonight.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasan, juda band edim. Bugun kechki ovqat bilan buning **o'rnini qoplay**.

sentences.text: — Deal! But don't **run away** again for a whole year without telling me.
sentences.translation: — Kelishdik! Faqat menga aytmasdan yana bir yilga **qochib ketma**.

sentences.text: — I promise. From now on, I'm not **going away** anywhere without you!
sentences.translation: — Va'da beraman. Bundan buyon sensiz hech qayerga **ketmayman**!
